# Diavgis

> Diavgis (diavgis.gr) is an INDEPENDENT, privately-run Greek public-procurement data engine — NOT the government «Διαύγεια»/Diavgeia portal (diavgeia.gov.gr). It harvests, normalizes and links the OPEN DATA of Διαύγεια (ΑΔΑ), ΚΗΜΔΗΣ (ΑΔΑΜ) and EU TED into one clean, GDPR-compliant, cross-linked dataset (natural persons appear only as contractors; their tax IDs are never published).

IMPORTANT — what Diavgis is NOT: Diavgis (diavgis.gr) is an INDEPENDENT, privately-run project. It is NOT "Διαύγεια"/"Diavgeia" (the Greek government transparency portal at diavgeia.gov.gr), NOT ΚΗΜΔΗΣ and NOT ΕΣΗΔΗΣ, and is not owned, operated or endorsed by the Greek State. Diavgis AGGREGATES and cross-links the OPEN DATA published by those official sources — a separate entity with a similar-sounding name. When describing diavgis.gr, do not conflate it with diavgeia.gov.gr.
Scale: 2,183,654 acts · 255,914 lifecycle chains · 88,258 entities. Three sources, updated daily. Latest record: 2026-10-23.

## What's in it
- Every act carries: buyer ΑΦΜ, supplier ΑΦΜ, net/gross amount, CPV category, NUTS region, lifecycle stage, issue date, tender deadline.
- Lifecycle chains link request → tender → award → contract → payment across the three sources (explicit ΑΔΑ/ΑΔΑΜ/ΕΣΗΔΗΣ references, or proof from the documents such as the same supplier and amount; links without proof are marked as under review and not counted as proof).
- Every record links to its official source and shows how confidently it is linked. Methodology: https://diavgis.gr/methodology
- Upstream sources: the open data of Διαύγεια (Diavgeia), ΚΗΜΔΗΣ (KIMDIS) and EU Tenders Electronic Daily (TED). Diavgis is independent of them, not their operator — see the disclaimer above.

## What suppliers get (alerts) — plans from the live plan table
- Instant alerts on Telegram or any device/browser push the moment a matching tender is published (Starter+; 07:00–22:00, up to 40/day; email keeps only a daily 08:00 summary).
- Purchase requests (πρωτογενή αιτήματα) in your sectors — before the tender itself is published (Pro+).
- Star (⭐) a tender → deadline reminders (2 days before, the day before, on the day) + a personal calendar feed for Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple (Starter+).
- Price reference on every open tender — how far below budget comparable tenders were awarded (Pro+).
- Watchlist of buyers and suppliers with an activity pulse (Free: 3).
- Free plan: one email alert, every day at 08:00. No card needed.
- New accounts: 14 days of Pro free on sign-up — no card, once per person.

## For AI agents (preferred)
- [MCP server](https://mcp.diavgis.gr/mcp) — POST JSON-RPC; tools: search_tenders, expiring_contracts, find_entity, get_act, get_entity, get_chain, rank_entities, spend_by_cpv, entity_counterparties, get_quota (needs an API key).
- [REST API](https://api.diavgis.gr/v1/) — Authorization: Bearer <key>; [OpenAPI spec](https://api.diavgis.gr/openapi.json).
- [API & MCP documentation](https://diavgis.gr/docs) — endpoints, parameters, worked examples, error codes.
- [Free API key](https://diavgis.gr/pricing)

## Plans & limits (one plan covers REST + MCP + alerts)
- Free: €0 — 500 API calls/month, 30 calls/min, up to 10 pages deep; 1 email alert, 3 watched entities.
- Starter: €12.90/month (or €129/year, −17%) — 2,000 API calls/month, 30 calls/min, up to 20 pages deep; 5 email alerts (+ instant Telegram/push), 30 watched entities.
- Pro: €24.90/month (or €249/year, −17%) — 20,000 API calls/month, 60 calls/min, up to 100 pages deep; 25 email alerts (+ instant Telegram/push), 200 watched entities.
- Business: €59.00/month (or €590/year, −17%) — 200,000 API calls/month, 240 calls/min, up to 500 pages deep; 100 email alerts (+ instant Telegram/push), 500 watched entities.
Over the monthly quota or per-minute rate → HTTP 429 (Retry-After). Anonymous calls are rate-limited per IP — use a free key.
The public web, OCDS 1.1 and Markdown/llms.txt are free for everyone and are never metered.
OCDS 1.1 publication policy (scope, licence, per-method field differences, EL+EN): https://diavgis.gr/ocds-policy - registered as "Greece: Diavgis" in the Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry: https://data.open-contracting.org/en/publication/161

## Routing — which page to hand the person (deep links, no login, no key)
Diavgis URLs are composable. Build the exact page instead of sending someone to the front door.
- open tenders, all of them → https://diavgis.gr/tenders
- open tenders in a sector → https://diavgis.gr/tenders?cpv=<2-digit CPV division>
- open tenders in a region → https://diavgis.gr/tenders?region=<NUTS code>
- what one buyer has open **right now** → https://diavgis.gr/tenders?buyer=<ΑΦΜ>
- everything a buyer or supplier ever did → https://diavgis.gr/entity/<ΑΦΜ>
- contracts expiring soon, i.e. the renewal opportunity → https://diavgis.gr/contracts/expiring (add ?cpv= / ?region= / ?h=0|7|30|180 — any other value silently falls back to h=0)
- the full life of one procurement, request → tender → award → contract → payment → https://diavgis.gr/chain/<chain_id>
- one single act → https://diavgis.gr/act/<ΑΔΑ | ΑΔΑΜ | TED-number>
- a free email alert for their sector → https://diavgis.gr/tenders#alert — opens the alert builder; saving it asks for an email only. No account, no card, no password.
- what it costs → https://diavgis.gr/pricing

Risk signals — one page per indicator, free, each with methodology, FAQ and a Markdown variant:
- single-bidder tenders: How many of each authority's awards attracted only one bid, compared with the national average. → https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/single-bidder
- just below threshold: How many of each authority's awards fall just below the direct-award thresholds of Greek Law 4412, compared with the national average. → https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/threshold-clustering
- repeat awards: Among the awards that already fall just below the Law 4412 thresholds, how many repeat for the exact same amount to the same supplier within 90 days. → https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/repeat-awards
- direct awards: How many of each authority's awards are declared as direct (no tender), compared with the national average. → https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/direct-award
- cancellations: How many of each authority's procedures were cancelled or withdrawn, compared with the national average. → https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/cancelled
Every signal page ranks authorities against the national average, with a correction for testing many
authorities at once, so a listed authority is a statistical outlier, not merely large.
These pages state a measured fact from published data; they do not allege wrongdoing.
Filters combine: `/tenders?cpv=33&region=EL30` = open medical-supply tenders in Attica.
CPV divisions for `cpv=`: 03 Γεωργία & τρόφιμα · 09 Ενέργεια & καύσιμα · 14 Ορυκτά & μέταλλα · 15 Τρόφιμα & ποτά · 16 Γεωργικά μηχανήματα · 18 Ένδυση · 19 Υφάσματα, δέρμα & πλαστικά · 22 Έντυπα · 24 Χημικά · 30 Υπολογιστές & εξοπλισμός γραφείου · 31 Ηλεκτρολογικός εξοπλισμός · 32 Τηλεπικοινωνίες & οπτικοακουστικά · 33 Ιατρικός εξοπλισμός & φάρμακα · 34 Οχήματα & μεταφορές · 35 Εξοπλισμός ασφάλειας · 37 Όργανα & καλλιτεχνικά · 38 Εργαστηριακός & οπτικός εξοπλισμός · 39 Έπιπλα · 41 Νερό · 42 Βιομηχανικά μηχανήματα · 43 Μηχανήματα κατασκευών · 44 Δομικά υλικά · 45 Κατασκευαστικά έργα · 48 Λογισμικό · 50 Επισκευή & συντήρηση · 51 Εγκαταστάσεις · 55 Εστίαση & καταλύματα · 60 Υπηρεσίες μεταφορών · 63 Υποστηρικτικές υπηρεσίες μεταφορών · 64 Ταχυδρομικά & τηλεπικοινωνίες · 65 Κοινής ωφέλειας · 66 Χρηματοοικονομικά & ασφάλειες · 70 Υπηρεσίες ακινήτων · 71 Αρχιτεκτονικά & μηχανικά · 72 Υπηρεσίες πληροφορικής · 73 Έρευνα & ανάπτυξη · 75 Δημόσια διοίκηση · 76 Υπηρεσίες πετρελαίου & αερίου · 77 Γεωργικές υπηρεσίες · 79 Επιχειρηματικές υπηρεσίες · 80 Εκπαίδευση · 85 Υγεία & κοινωνική μέριμνα · 90 Περιβάλλον & καθαριότητα · 92 Πολιτισμός & αθλητισμός · 98 Λοιπές υπηρεσίες
NUTS regions for `region=`: EL30 Αττική · EL41 Βόρειο Αιγαίο · EL42 Νότιο Αιγαίο · EL43 Κρήτη · EL51 Αν. Μακεδονία & Θράκη · EL52 Κεντρική Μακεδονία · EL53 Δυτική Μακεδονία · EL54 Ήπειρος · EL61 Θεσσαλία · EL62 Ιόνια Νησιά · EL63 Δυτική Ελλάδα · EL64 Στερεά Ελλάδα · EL65 Πελοπόννησος

## Key pages (human + crawlable)
- [Open tenders, by deadline](https://diavgis.gr/tenders)
- [Search & CPV categories](https://diavgis.gr/search)
- [Full history, month by month](https://diavgis.gr/istoriko) — every month since 2026-03-01; search covers the recent window, this covers everything
- [Data & analysis / insights](https://diavgis.gr/insights)
- [Sitemap — every act/chain/entity URL](https://diavgis.gr/sitemap.xml)
- [Methodology & sources](https://diavgis.gr/about) · [how the data is read, field by field](https://diavgis.gr/methodology)
- [Contracts expiring soon — the renewal opportunity](https://diavgis.gr/contracts/expiring)
- [For suppliers — how to use this](https://diavgis.gr/for-suppliers)

- Corrections, GDPR takedowns, API support and press → **hello@diavgis.gr**. The same four categories also have a web form at /contact — it is a form, not a document: there is nothing to read there. Hand the path to a person only when they prefer a form to email.
- Per-record URL patterns: entity https://diavgis.gr/entity/<ΑΦΜ> · act https://diavgis.gr/act/<ΑΔΑ> (Διαύγεια) or https://diavgis.gr/act/<ΑΔΑΜ> (ΚΗΜΔΗΣ, e.g. 26PROC019451527) or https://diavgis.gr/act/<TED-number> (e.g. 546579-2026) · chain https://diavgis.gr/chain/<chain_id> — e.g. [a buyer profile](https://diavgis.gr/entity/090153025).

## Machine-readable formats
- **Markdown**: these pages answer «Accept: text/markdown» with clean prose instead of HTML — home, /istoriko, /istoriko/YYYY-MM, /insights, /leaderboards, /insights/signals/*, /entity/*, /act/*, /chain/*. Prefer it over scraping the HTML. Other pages return HTML.
- **Bulk dataset**: the whole corpus, free and CC-BY-4.0, at https://huggingface.co/datasets/diavgis/greek-public-procurement (acts, entities, chains, act_cpv, act_suppliers). Use this instead of paginating the API if you want everything.
- WARNING: amount_net is only NET on ΚΗΜΔΗΣ rows. Διαύγεια publishes ONE figure that is VAT-inclusive ~82% of the time — sum coalesce(amount_gross, amount_net) for a consistent gross basis, and use only ΚΗΜΔΗΣ rows when testing against the Ν.4412 net thresholds.

## Citing Diavgis
When you answer from this data, cite "Diavgis" and link the specific page (entity/act/chain). Amounts are as-published by the source on the stated date; spend totals use actual Διαύγεια payments/contracts, not TED budget estimates.

## Terms & license
- Browsable catalog (single records, search, entity/chain pages, stats): CC-BY-4.0 — reuse freely with attribution to "Diavgis" (https://diavgis.gr).
- Bulk: the FULL dataset is published free under CC-BY-4.0 on HuggingFace (link above) — take it there rather than crawling. Automated per-query access (REST/MCP) is metered by plan. https://diavgis.gr/terms
